caseNameFull: Weinmann v. McGrath, Attorney General, Successor to the Alien Property Custodian
attorneys: George T. Goggin for appellant., Solicitor General Perlman for McGrath, Attorney General, appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Black dissents.
